domain.description: The domain name for which WHOIS information is to be fetched.

tools.name: qr_code
tools.description: Creates a QR code by making a GET request to the QR code API with the given URL.

url.description: The URL to be included in the QR code. Defaults to 'https://rapidapi.com/'.

tools.name: check_if_text_contains_profanity
tools.description: Check if a given text contains profanity using the Purgomalum API.

text.description: The text to be checked for profanity.

query: Imagine you have a 20-sided die. What is the probability of rolling a sum of 25 with 4 dice?

tools.name: cagr
tools.description: Calculates the Compound Annual Growth Rate (CAGR) of an investment.

start_value.description: The initial value of the investment.

end_value.description: The final value of the investment.

years.description: The number of years between the initial and final values.

tools.name: binomial_probability
tools.description: Calculates the probability of getting exactly k successes in n independent trials,

n.description: The total number of trials.

k.description: The number of successes.

p.description: The probability of success in each trial.

tools.name: dice_roll_probability
tools.description: Calculates the probability of rolling a specific sum with a given number of dice, each having a certain number of faces.

target_sum.description: The target sum to calculate the probability for.

num_dice.description: The number of dice being rolled.

num_faces.description: The number of faces on each die. Defaults to 6.

query: What is the daily calorie intake and macronutrient distribution for a sedentary 50-year-old female who weighs 55 kg, is 158 cm tall, and wants to maintain her weight?

tools.name: calculate_calorie_intake
tools.description: Calculates the recommended daily calorie intake and macronutrient distribution based on personal characteristics and goals.

activity_level.description: Activity level on a scale of 1 to 5 (1 = sedentary, 5 = extremely active).

query: What is the likely gender of the name 'Kelly' and what are the crime data for the location at latitude 41.8781 and longitude -87.6298 for the month of May 2022?

tools.name: street_level_outcomes
tools.description: Fetches street-level outcomes such as crime data for a given location, either at a specific point, within a 1-mile radius, or within a custom area for a specified date.

date.description: The date for which to fetch outcomes, formatted as 'YYYY-MM'.

lat.description: The latitude of the specific location.

lng.description: The longitude of the specific location.

tools.name: genderize
tools.description: Determines the likely gender of a given name using the Genderize API.

name.description: The name to analyze for gender determination.

query: Get the search results for a YouTube influencer search with the ID 'abc123'

tools.name: country_details
tools.description: Fetches the details for a specific country from the GeoDB API, including information on the number of regions.

countryid.description: An ISO-3166 country code or WikiData id representing the country.

asciimode.description: If set to True, display results using ASCII characters.

languagecode.description: The language code to display the results in the specified language.

tools.name: getsearchresults
tools.description: Fetches the results from a specific YouTube influencer search using the provided search ID.

is_id.description: Unique identifier of the search.

tools.name: image_to_text_ocr
tools.description: Extracts text from an image using the Google Lens OCR API and provides detailed detections at the paragraph, sentence, and word levels.

url.description: The URL of the image from which to extract text.

language.description: The language of the results, specified as a 2-letter ISO 639-1 code (e.g., 'en' for English). Defaults to 'en'.

query: What is the information for pizza with ID 5 and the JSON response for pizza with ID 7

tools.name: get_specific_pizza
tools.description: Fetches a specific pizza by its ID from the RapidAPI service.

is_id.description: The ID of the pizza to retrieve.

query: What genres are available for Canvas webtoons in French?

tools.name: originals_titles_get_recommend
tools.description: Fetches recommended comics similar to a given comic title number.

titleno.description: The title number for which recommendations are to be fetched. This corresponds to the `titleNo` field returned by the `/originals/titles/list` or `/originals/titles/list-by-rank` endpoints of the Webtoon API.

language.description: The language preference for the recommendations. Defaults to 'en'. Accepted values include 'en', 'zh-hant', 'de', 'fr', 'es', 'th', and 'id'.

tools.name: canvas_genres_list
tools.description: Fetches a list of genres in the canvas category from the Webtoon API.

language.description: The language in which to return the genres. Acceptable values are 'en', 'zh-hant', 'de', 'fr', 'es', 'th', and 'id'. Default is 'en'.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Searches the Steam shop for a given term and returns the results.

term.description: The search term to query in the Steam shop.

page.description: The page number of search results to retrieve. Default is 1.

query: Check if Eevee can learn the 'swift' move and predict the evolution rate for the lion using the Darwin model over 10 years.

tools.name: geocode_city
tools.description: Retrieves the latitude and longitude coordinates of a given city using the Maps.co Geocoding API.

city.description: The name of the city.

tools.name: predict_evolution_rate
tools.description: Predict the evolutionary rate for a specific species for a given timeframe.

species.description: The species that the evolution rate will be predicted for.

years.description: Number of years for the prediction.

model.description: The model used to make the prediction, options: 'Darwin', 'Lamarck', default is 'Darwin'.

tools.name: get_pokemon_move_info
tools.description: Retrieves information about a Pokémon's move using the PokéAPI.

move_name.description: The name of the move to check. Defaults to "run".

tools.name: get_holidays_by_year
tools.description: Retrieves the list of public holidays for a given year and country using the Nager.Date API.

year.description: The year for which to retrieve the holidays.

country_code.description: The two-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code.

query: Find the equilibrium index of an integer list [1, -1, 3, 2, -1, 4, -2, 1]

tools.name: find_equilibrium_index
tools.description: Finds the equilibrium index of a list, where the sum of elements on the left is equal to the sum of elements on the right.

query: Generate 10 fake user profiles and get the search results for a YouTube influencer search identified by its unique ID.

tools.name: verify_plate_number_location
tools.description: Fetches information about the state and LGA (Local Government Area) associated with a given Nigerian plate number code.

platecodeloc.description: The first three characters of a Nigerian plate number.

tools.name: directory
tools.description: Retrieves all the Local Area Codes from a given country.

country.description: An ISO 2-letter country code or the name of the country in English.

tools.name: getsearchresults
tools.description: Fetches the results from a specific YouTube influencer search using the provided search ID.

is_id.description: Unique identifier of the search.

tools.name: random_profiles
tools.description: Generates a list of fake user profiles given a specified size using the Toolbench RapidAPI service.

size.description: A string indicating the number of fake user profiles to generate. Defaults to '1'.

query: Retrieve the TEMA data for Bitcoin (BTC/USD) with a time period of 14 and output size of 60 for the past 3 months using the 1-hour interval, but in CSV format.

tools.name: tema
tools.description: Calculates the Triple Exponential Moving Average (TEMA) for a given financial instrument.

interval.description: Interval between two consecutive points in the time series. Supports: `1min`, `5min`, `15min`, `30min`, `45min`, `1h`, `2h`, `4h`, `1day`, `1week`, `1month`.

symbol.description: Instrument symbol, can be any equity, index, ETF, forex, or cryptocurrency (e.g., `AAPL`, `EUR/USD`, `ETH/BTC`).

format.description: Format of the returned data, either `csv` or `json`. Defaults to `json`.

outputsize.description: Number of data points in the result. Default is `30`.

time_period.description: Time period over which the TEMA is calculated. Default is `9`.

series_type.description: Type of price data to analyze. Supports: `open`, `high`, `low`, `close`. Default is `close`.

query: Using my rapidapi key, get me the channel links for the gmhikaru channel, but only return the JSON response

tools.name: get_channel_links
tools.description: Fetches the links associated with a specified channel from the Kick API using the provided RapidAPI key.

channel_name.description: The name of the channel to retrieve links for. Defaults to 'gmhikaru'.
